item.title: Re: What’s your favorite canon?
item.content:encoded:
S&C Plastics. I love the character-driven stories and the setting which allows styles to get around some of the usual limits of SCP writing.

I also enjoy Third Law, mostly for introducing all of the lore about the broader anomalous community and the Three Portlands.

item.title: Re: What’s your favorite canon?
item.content:encoded: Tbh, I really enjoyed Broken Masqurade and Rat's Nest. Only thing is, it was kind of odd how the story progressed in Rats Nest and Broken Masquerade was just… eh. Hard to follow along the story, but I still enjoyed it

item.title: What’s your favorite canon?
item.content:encoded:
Personally. I’m a fan of the resurrection canon. Even though they killed off one of my favorite characters, Dr. Kondraki I like the idea of continuing the central storyline of The SCP Foundation.

And it has some truly awesome moments. Like agents Adams and iris taking on an army of replicating
Zombies.

That secured as my favorite in my book.
